description: One line of a song lyric

value.description: The actual text of this line

start.description: The start time of the lyrics, relative to the start time of the track, in milliseconds. If this is not part of synced lyrics, start __must__ be omitted

end.description: The optional end time of the lyrics, relative to the start time of the track, in milliseconds. When present, start must also be present and end must be greater than or equal to start. If this is not part of synced lyrics, end must be omitted
